text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One evening, a stony-faced Tamamo Cross and Ines Fujin meet up at the back of the school.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I got da carrots and potatoes from the grocers near the station, just like you asked!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You're a lifesaver! Here you go, one bottle of shampoo and a toothbrush!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, thanks a bunch. This really helps me out. It's great havin' a fellow bargain hunter 'round.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hehe. With you here, I can take advantage of multiple sales at once!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: No one can beat us when it comes to nabbin' all the sales in town! Man, what a thrill!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh! As thanks, I'll letcha in on some real good intel!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: No way! You can make that with potatoes and milk?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Shh! Someone could be eavesdroppin' for all we know!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Wait… This is something I should keep a secret?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that, the two bargain hunters talk about their scrimping strategies until dusk.
